input: Research tandem skydiving jump packages nearby

gold.taskTitle: Research Nearby Tandem Skydiving Jump Packages
gold.taskDescription: Find and compare tandem skydiving jump packages available at drop zones near the user's location.

questions.title: What city or region should the search be centered on?
questions.description: Identify the user's location or preferred search area for nearby drop zones.

questions.title: How far are you willing to travel for the jump?
questions.description: Determine the maximum distance or travel time the user considers acceptable.

questions.title: Do you have a target date or timeframe in mind?
questions.description: Find out if the user has a specific date, weekend, or season they are aiming for.

questions.title: Is this jump for yourself or a group?
questions.description: Clarify whether the user is booking solo or needs packages for multiple people.

questions.title: What is your total budget per person for the jump?
questions.description: Establish a price range to filter and compare packages appropriately.

questions.title: Are video or photo add-ons important to your decision?
questions.description: Determine if media packages are a priority feature when evaluating options.

questions.title: Have you skydived before or is this your first time?
questions.description: Understand the user's experience level to tailor recommendations toward beginner-friendly or more advanced drop zones.
